range: From {{from}} to {{to}}. Days in the plan: {{days}}.

summary.howItWorks: The plan is recalculated every time you open the portal. Work you did not finish moves to the next day that has time for that subject, and a day can grow by at most 15%. On the day before an exam, that subject gets only preparation for the paper, no new topics; the other subjects carry on as planned. After its last exam a subject leaves the plan.

debt.title: Catching up: {{time}} from earlier days
debt.text: This work moves to the next days that have time for the subject.

unplaced.title: Not everything fits before the exams
unplaced.text: Catch up on a weekend, or raise the daily study time in Settings.

finished.title: The plan is complete
finished.text: All the exams are behind you. There is nothing left to plan.

day.restText: This weekday is set to 0 minutes in Settings, so nothing is planned.
day.empty: Nothing is planned for this day.
